title: USF-173 Cache and Eventing Service Disposition Matrix

humanDecision.summary: Cache and eventing are separate semantic roles. NATS is the composed event-bus provider where event-bus semantics are claimed; Redis-compatible composed support is required where Redis, cache, distributed runtime state, queue-adjacent, expiration, or Redis-specific semantics are claimed; in-memory substitutes are accepted only where semantically permitted and non-equivalence is recorded.

semanticRoleClassification.nonEquivalenceBoundary: NATS event-bus publish/readback proof is not Redis cache, expiration, eviction, persistence, key-space, distributed runtime state, queue-adjacent, or Redis wire-protocol proof.
Redis cache proof is now direct bounded local Compose evidence; NATS event-bus proof and process-memory proof remain separate evidence classes and are not used as Redis provider substitutes.
In-memory stores may prove hermetic local semantic paths only when the relevant proof row permits them. They are not equivalent to Redis cache semantics or NATS composed event-bus provider evidence.

cacheEventingDisposition.riskStatement: Redis cache provider semantics, expiration, eviction, persistence, tenant key isolation, queue-adjacent use, retry, audit, teardown, and provider failure modes could be overclaimed from NATS event-bus or in-memory evidence.
cacheEventingDisposition.treatment: record the cache/eventing semantic split in USF-173, keep event-bus and in-memory evidence separate from Redis provider proof, and record USF-207 bounded local Redis SDK proof without readiness claims
deferredEvidence: API runtime cache-port integration proof remains unclaimed
worker runtime cache-port integration proof remains unclaimed
live/provider-managed Redis supplier, credential, and environment promotion evidence remains unclaimed
backup/restore, DR, production alerting, and operator access readiness remain unclaimed

scopeCovered: bounded local composed-test event-bus publish/readback proof
runtime manifest links NATS to the nats service catalogue row
SDK use is confined to the adapter boundary
proof output remains synthetic and tenant-safe
limits: not Redis expiration, eviction, persistence, or key-space proof
not test, staging, production, SOC, ISO, full dev, or full React parity readiness

redisProviderBoundary.providerRegistryEvidence: packages/core/src/index.ts records cache-redis-composed-test as bounded local Compose proof and cache-redis-deferred for remaining live/provider-managed boundaries.

inMemorySubstituteBoundary.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: In-memory cache or event evidence may prove local hermetic paths only when the relevant proof row permits it. It is not equivalent to Redis composed cache semantics, NATS composed event-bus provider semantics, Redis/NATS SDK boundaries, provider failure modes, cross-process visibility, or live provider evidence.
scopeCovered: repository records Redis as a profile-gated bounded local Compose provider proof
runtime provider manifest keeps Redis outside API/worker active provider binding refs
provider registry records cache-redis-composed-test plus cache-redis-deferred
validator rejects event-bus or in-memory Redis substitution and readiness overclaim
enterprise evidence rows record tenant, retention, audit, privacy, supplier, incident, and cache/eventing boundaries
limits: in-memory proof is not Redis provider proof
NATS proof is not Redis cache proof
no API runtime cache binding claim
no worker runtime cache binding claim
no cache readiness or Redis readiness claim
